The IMO operates through a matrix of employees and consultants across the Bank, with the central programme office team and dedicated consultants reporting directly to the Vice President. This is a cross-bank role. The Integration Management Office is the connective tissue between the Executive Leadership Team, the executive sponsors who own each workstream's outcomes, the Board and its committees, the Bank's regulators, and the vendor providing transition services. The Vice President sets the cadence, the control structure and the reporting spine those audiences rely on, and converts complexity into decisions and execution plans. The role is deliberately broad rather than deep. This role is focused on expanding the adoption of our Maritime offerings within the region, working closely with the Product and Commercial teams to strengthen our market position and ensure consistent revenue growth across both new and existing clients. Reporting to the Maritime Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a driven individual who can achieve and excel in target.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – AI Products
jobs.description_text: Kpler's AI products are changing how commodity and maritime professionals access and interpret market intelligence. Through our AI surfaces, MCP server, which can be used within tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and enterprise copilots, and our AI Assistant embedded in the Kpler terminal, customers can ask questions in natural language and receive analysis grounded in Kpler data. We are looking for a technically minded, customer-facing Sales Specialist – AI Products to support the adoption and growth of Kpler's AI offering globally. You will work closely with prospects and existing customers, demonstrating how our AI products can address their specific needs, integrate into their existing technology environments and deliver tangible commercial value. Acting as the technical counterpart to our Commercial teams, you will lead customer demonstrations, design and deliver workshops, support integrations and help customers understand the capabilities, value and security of our AI products. You will also play an important role in shaping the AI product roadmap through direct customer feedback and market insights.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – Dry Bulk
jobs.description_text: As a Sales Specialist in Kpler’s Commercial team, you will be responsible for developing Kpler’s Dry Bulk sales penetration across the EMEA region, with a focus on Metals, Mining, Agriculture and Freight. You will act as a key growth engine for Kpler’s Dry Bulk suite of solutions, opening new markets, winning new logos, and identifying opportunities to grow revenue across both new and existing clients. You will manage a defined book of business and own the sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through to pitching, negotiation and closing. Working closely with Sales, Research, Marketing and Business Unit teams, you will develop a deep understanding of the Dry Bulk market and Kpler’s offering, using this knowledge to position our solutions as strategic tools for clients and strengthen our market position across EMEA. Reporting to the Dry Bulk Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a proactive, commercially driven individual who is motivated by achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – Financial Flows (Americas)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Sales Specialist to drive adoption and growth of Kpler’s CTA and Financial Flows solutions across AMER. This role is focused on expanding the adoption of our Kpler Financial Flows (KFF, formerly Bridgeton) offerings within the region, working closely with the Product and Commercial teams to strengthen our market position and ensure consistent revenue growth across both new and existing clients. The ideal candidate will have a high level of energy and enthusiasm for engaging with senior commodity traders, a passion for commodity markets and trading strategies, and strong intellectual curiosity. Reporting to the KFF Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a driven individual who can achieve and exceed targets.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Cruise
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer within our Maritime domain, you will lead the backend architecture and streaming services that process high-volume vessel tracking, port intelligence, and maritime trade flows. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. Operating with high autonomy under a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture, you will play a crucial role in modernizing core services, elevating technical standards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners and client-facing technical teams.

jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.

Working within a senior crew alongside product managers and designers, you will unify our web applications on a shared monorepo and micro-frontend architecture while building platform-level microservices that power capabilities for around 20 feature teams. Your technical leadership and engineering standards will directly shape how millions of global users interact with real-time trade, energy, and maritime intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior long-term oil analyst
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Long-Term Oil Analyst, you will own Kpler’s strategic multi-decade outlook for crude oil, refined products, and alternative liquid fuels within the evolving global energy system. Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways.

jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Research Analyst for Middle Distillates, you will own Kpler’s East of Suez diesel, gasoil, and jet/kerosene intelligence across the Middle East, India, China, Singapore, and the wider Asia-Pacific region. Operating at the center of global physical oil flows, you will connect regional supply dynamics to West of Suez balances through rigorous arbitrage and trade flow analysis. In this autonomous individual contributor role, your insights will set the regional editorial direction and deliver high-conviction analysis to guide commercial traders, refiners, and institutional investors worldwide.

jobs.title: Senior Tanker Research Analyst
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Tanker Research Analyst based in Singapore, you will serve as Kpler's regional authority on liquid tanker freight, driving the expansion of our maritime intelligence footprint across Asia. Sitting at the vital intersection of physical vessel tracking and commercial shipping fundamentals, you will transform raw tanker movements and freight arbitrage data into clear, forward-looking market insights. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your research will directly empower global charterers, traders, and shipowners to navigate volatile freight markets and make informed commercial decisions.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Avionics Engineer
jobs.description_text: Avionics Engineer DESCRIPTION Avionics Engineers play a critical role in mission success, integrating hardware that generates thousands of pounds of thrust with software that ensures precise guidance and control. They drive system architecture, validation, and next-generation avionics development to enable reliable and high-performance flight. This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Lead Program Systems Engineer, Cyclops (remote considered)
jobs.description_text: Lead Program Systems Engineer, Cyclops DESCRIPTION The Lead Systems Engineer for the Cyclops Interceptor Program owns system level requirements, architecture, interface definition, and verification planning for Long Wall’s interceptor. This role provides the technical backbone of the program, ensuring that all engineering work across propulsion, avionics, structures, mechanisms, GNC, software, and integration aligns with a coherent and traceable system design. Operating closely with the program’s Chief Engineer, Project Engineer and Responsible Engineers, the Lead Systems Engineer creates and maintains the structured technical framework that enables disciplined development. They ensure that architectures scale, requirements remain traceable, interfaces stay stable, and verification flows match both government‑funded testing and rapid internal development. P4: $150,000 to $190,000 P5: $185,000 to $230,000 The posted pay range reflects the base salary range for this role in California only, and is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Opportunistic - General Application
jobs.description_text: General Application DESCRIPTION We want to hear from you. Long Wall is growing quickly across engineering, manufacturing, test, and business operations, and new positions open regularly. This general application lets you share your background with our recruiting team so we can reach out when a role matches your skills and interests. We review general applications on a rolling basis and will contact you directly if there is a potential fit. When a specific posting matches your background, we encourage you to apply to that role as well. Note: Submitting here is not an application to a specific position and does not guarantee an interview.

jobs.title: Program Chief Engineer, Cyclops (Remote considered)
jobs.description_text: Program Chief Engineer, Cyclops DESCRIPTION The Chief Engineer for Cyclops is the ultimate technical authority for Long Wall’s major interceptor product. This role owns the technical baseline, architecture, requirements, configuration, verification strategy, and overall technical mission success of interceptor products. The chief engineer operates as a peer to program management, jointly leading the program while ensuring that technical integrity is never compromised by schedule pressure or external commitments. This role integrates the work of systems engineering, mission assurance, engineering disciplines, and project management into a coherent, defensible technical execution plan. The chief engineer ensures that all technical decisions are traceable, analytically supported, and aligned with customer expectations and mission needs. P5 - $190,000 to $235,000/yr P6 - $225,000 to $275,000/yr The posted pay range reflects the base salary range for this role in California only, and is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Safety & Mission Assurance Engineer (remote considered)
jobs.description_text: Safety & Mission Assurance Engineer DESCRIPTION The Safety & Mission Assurance (SMA) Engineer provides independent oversight of reliability, safety, configuration compliance, and mission readiness for Long Wall’s major programs. This role ensures that every design decision, integration change, and test plan preserves system reliability and safety, aligns with verification requirements, and supports mission success for internal and government programs. The SMA Specialist partners closely with systems engineering, chief engineering, program management, quality, and integration/test operations to evaluate technical risk, approve readiness criteria, and embed disciplined safety and reliability practices into a fast-paced development environment. They maintain independence while being deeply integrated with engineering and program execution, a core principle of Long Wall’s mission assurance philosophy. P3: $135,000 to $165,000/yr P4: $160,000 to $185,000/yr The posted pay range reflects the base salary range for this role in California only, and is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: Sr. Project Engineer (SRM), Cyclops DESCRIPTION The Project Engineer for the Cyclops Interceptor Program drives the rapid engineering and integration effort that underpins development of Long Wall’s major interceptor system. This role ensures that internal priorities, resources, and schedules remain synchronized with technical baselines, enabling fast, disciplined execution within a private‑investment‑driven development environment complemented by government‑funded testing. For this role, specific focus will be on solid rocket motor (SRM) development, ensuring propulsion engineering activities remain aligned with the Cyclops technical baseline and program priorities. While the Program Manager handles customer‑facing commitments, the Project Engineer owns the engineering‑centric project flow: coordinating cross‑functional development, maintaining internal schedule fidelity, resolving execution roadblocks, and ensuring technical work stays aligned with project goals, verified requirements, and readiness needs. The project engineer partners closely with chief engineering, responsible engineers, systems engineering, and mission assurance to protect technical integrity while ensuring consistent development velocity. Work location Note: This role is remote, based out of Huntsville AL. - As Long Wall grows, we anticipate establishing a site in the Huntsville area. jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data Products
jobs.description_text: Pelmorex operates at the intersection of weather, digital media, advertising, consumer technology, and B2B weather intelligence. Across the company, we generate and manage an unusually broad and valuable set of data: large-scale weather forecasts and observations, historical weather archives, consumer behavioural and location signals, digital product engagement, advertising yield, and commercial customer data. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. jobs.description_text: To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai As the Safety and Systems Technical Program Manager, you will drive the execution of our safety and systems engineering development efforts for our autonomous vehicle platforms. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Team Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems. We are a distributed team, working in the UK and US. Who are we looking for? The London Data Infrastructure team is looking for engineers who are passionate about and enable the next generation of automotive software development. This is a Hunter role, so you will be prospecting, developing, and closing new business while focusing on the clients’ requirements. Anyscale is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company in a large and growing market. As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for the architectural evolution of our control plane and data plane, ensuring that our "infinite laptop" vision scales to meet the most demanding distributed AI workloads in the world. jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's security and compliance needs are growing as we work with larger and more demanding customers. Compliance is increasingly a customer-facing, contractual function rather than an internal exercise, and we are looking for someone to own it. This role owns that function end to end: our audits, our evidence base, our risk register, and the security diligence that customers put us through before and during a contract. You will work directly with the Head of Security and across engineering, IT, legal, and sales. This is a program-ownership role with the autonomy and accountability that implies. You will not have a senior compliance function above you to defer to; you are that function. In your first year, success looks like a complete and defensible evidence base with clean audit outcomes, a repeatable way to answer customer security diligence, and a risk register that leadership actually uses. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 programs, and future frameworks as we take them on, including scope, evidence, control operation, and the relationship with our external auditors. - Own and complete the control evidence base in our compliance automation platform, moving controls from partially substantiated to audit-ready and keeping them there. - Lead security diligence for enterprise and regulated customers: security questionnaires, audit responses, right-to-audit requests, and the recurring reporting these customers require. - Own the risk regi

jobs.title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's need to detect and respond to security events across its production and corporate environments is growing as the company scales. We're looking for a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to own detection engineering and to lead incident response when it counts, coordinating the response and driving it to resolution. This is a high-ownership role with real room to shape how detection and response works at Anyscale. You will own the detection pipeline, the response runbooks, and incident response, reporting to the Head of Security and partnering with engineering. This role is based in India. In your first year, success looks like strong detection coverage across our cloud, endpoint, and runtime telemetry, a working correlation and alerting pipeline, and incident response runbooks that have been exercised in practice. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and build detection coverage across cloud, endpoint, and runtime telemetry. - Own a centralized correlation and alerting capability that turns telemetry into actionable detections. - Own incident response: runbooks, escalation paths, and coordination during an incident, across corporate and production environments. - Drive detection of anomalous activity across the environments we run, including our Kubernetes footprint. - Tune detections to keep signal high and noise low, and measure detection and response performance such as mean time to detect and respond. - Run incident retrospectives and feed lessons back into de

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Ray Data
jobs.description_text: About the role: Anyscale is looking for an engineering leader to manage the open source Ray Data team. Ray Data https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/data/data.html is the Python-native data processing engine for AI workloads on Ray. It handles multimodal and structured data and powers batch inference, data loading for distributed training, and large-scale preprocessing. The team owns the open source library end to end, including: - The streaming execution engine, including scheduling, backpressure, and resource management across CPUs and GPUs - Batch inference for LLMs and multimodal models, including integrations with inference engines such as vLLM - Data loading for production training workloads with Ray Train and popular ML frameworks - Connectors for data sources and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Lance, and cloud object storage - Performance, stability, and fault tolerance at large scale This is a first-line engineering management role where you'll lead a team of engineers, stay involved in technical design and code, and own the team's roadmap within the open source project. Ray Data has a large and active community, so you'll also work closely with external contributors to review designs, guide technical direction, and support the project's continued growth and success. The team plays an important role in the broader Ray ecosystem and contributes directly to Anyscale's success. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Set the technical direction and roadmap for open source Ray Data, ba

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale’s product security needs are growing as we ship to larger and more demanding customers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to own our secure software development lifecycle and to be engineering’s partner on building security into the product. Reporting to the Head of Security, you will work in close partnership with engineering. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will own and operate a scalable SSDL, partner with engineering on security features and secure design, review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and own how we find, track, drive to resolution and report on vulnerabilities in what we ship. This is a product security role with platform depth, not a cloud security role. This role is based in India. In your first year, success looks like an SSDL that scales with engineering rather than gating it, including how we build with AI coding agents, security review embedded in how new initiatives ship, and accurate, on-demand vulnerability reporting backed by a working path to resolution. What You’ll Do - Own and operate a scalable secure software development lifecycle: threat modeling, security requirements, secure design practices, and scanning that engineering can readily adopt. - Define how our SSDL works when AI writes and ships code: guardrails, review, and scanning for coding agents, MCP integrations, and LLM-powered features. - Partner with engineering on security features and secure-by-design architec

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: SENIOR CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEER At Anyscale https://www.anyscale.com/, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's security needs are growing as we operate more production and cloud infrastructure for larger and more demanding customers. We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of that infrastructure. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you will own how our production and cloud environments are hardened, isolated, and monitored. You will set and drive the direction for infrastructure and production security, reporting to the Head of Security and partnering closely with the wider engineering organization. This role is based in the San Francisco, Bay Area. In your first year, success looks like hardened and well-segmented production environments, strong runtime security coverage across our container footprint, and a clear, defensible story for how we secure the infrastructure our customers rely on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the security posture of Anyscale's production and cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure, including hardening, network segmentation, and tenant isolation. - Own runtime security coverage across our Kubernetes environments, from deployment through detection of anomalous activity. - Partner with engineering on secure infrastructure architecture and the secure design of our production environments. - Own cloud security posture

jobs.title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes. Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle. L'équipe de Lyft Urban Solutions à Montréal est en pleine croissance, et nous recherchons un(e) Analyste en planification des actifs. Ce rôle soutiendra la planification et l'allocation des pièces de rechange dans tous les marchés de micromobilité où Lyft est présente. Become an expert in marketplace trends and support weekly reporting structures for the Rideshare organization. Develop domain-specific subject matter expertise in our lever portfolio and support cross-functional initiatives to improve existing products and develop new ones.
